title: Failure of oddness for the AND function
statement: For every integer $n>1$, the function on $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ that outputs $-1$ when every coordinate is $-1$ and outputs $1$ otherwise is not odd; that is, it does not satisfy $f(-x)=-f(x)$ for every input $x$.
